title: Fill rate dropped 45% on Premium Video line item (LI-5501)
body: Fill rate on the Premium Video line item (LI-5501), running on the seat-back in-flight entertainment screens, dropped from ~93% to 48% starting around 13:50 UTC. Roughly 13,600 expected impressions per hour are going unfilled, leaving ad slots blank. No creative errors are reported and demand partners are healthy elsewhere, so this looks like an eligibility/targeting change rather than a demand outage.
